instructions_to_main_agent: Execute these exact Tailwind class swaps. This is a polish pass across existing .js files. DO NOT restructure HTML excessively or add any new npm packages. Follow the before/after pairs directly.
highest_impact_change: Killing 'shadow-md' and replacing it with crisp 1px borders (`border-slate-200`) and microscopic shadows (`shadow-sm` or none). This single change transitions an app from looking like a 2018 Bootstrap template to a modern 2024 Linear/Notion clone.

polish_checklist.description: Pick ONE strict radius scale to kill the 'mixed radius' chaos. Use `rounded-md` for small interactives, `rounded-xl` for large surfaces.
polish_checklist.before: rounded, rounded-lg, rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl mixed everywhere

polish_checklist.description: Purge all `gray-*` and `grey-*` mixed tokens. Standardize on `slate-*` for a cooler, modern neutral base.
The app canvas must be off-white to make white cards pop effectively.
polish_checklist.before: bg-white or bg-gray-50 on the main wrapper
polish_checklist.after: bg-slate-50 on the main wrapper, with bg-white on individual cards

polish_checklist.description: Standardize the heading scale. Modern apps use tighter tracking and heavier weights for headings.
polish_checklist.after: H1: `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900` | H2: `text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900`

polish_checklist.description: Establish a consistent, legible body text system.
Flatten the primary buttons, remove huge padding, add subtle hover transition.
polish_checklist.before: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 shadow-md
polish_checklist.after: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors

polish_checklist.description: Sharp, subtle borders for secondary actions. No more heavy shadows.
polish_checklist.before: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 rounded-lg shadow
polish_checklist.after: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

polish_checklist.description: Make destructive actions obvious but not overwhelming (light bg, colored text).
polish_checklist.after: bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

polish_checklist.description: Kill 2018 drop shadows. Shift to 'tactile' 1px borders with microscopic shadow.
Modernize the feeling of space. Cards need more breathing room inside.
Forms that look like Stripe: 1px border, crisp focus rings, no harsh blue outlines.
polish_checklist.after: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent transition-all

polish_checklist.description: Standardize the top of every dashboard page (Tenant, Admin, Platform).
polish_checklist.after: flex items-center justify-between mb-8 (Left: flex-col with H1 and optional text-sm subtitle | Right: flex gap-3 items-center)

polish_checklist.description: Add hover states to table rows so the app feels responsive.
Apply a standardized focus-visible ring to all interactive elements for accessibility and polish.
Add testing attributes to all actionable elements.
polish_checklist.after: Add `data-testid="{kebab-case-role}"` to every modified interactive component.
